paite: "Ka mit toh thukhun ka na bawl khinta; bangchi in nungak ka en theita dia?
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

paite: "Ahihleh tunglam Pathian a kipan in ka tantuan bang ahia, tungsang a Bangkim hihthei a kipan in ka goutan?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

paite: Midikloute tung ah siatna, gitlouh nasemte tung ah gawtna atung kei maw?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

paite: Ama'n ka lampite amu kei a hia? ka kalsuante asim vek kei a hia?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and number all my steps?

paite: "Thuzuau toh na om a, huai a ka khe khem ding a kinoh ahihleh;
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

paite: bukna diktak ah hon buk dih ua, Pathian in ka thutakna thei hen!
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

paite: Ka kalsuan lampi a kipan a na pial hiam, ka lungtang in ka mitte na zui hiam, ka khutte ah nin himhim na belh hiam;
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

paite: Huchi ka hihleh, chi tuh ning, midang in ne hen; ahi, ka lou a piang bulkalh khiak hi hen.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

paite: "Ka lungtang numei lam a khem a om a, ka inveng kongkhak ka na ngak takleh;
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

paite: huchi ahih takleh ka zi in midang a ding in an su henla, midangte amah tung ah kun uhen.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

paite: Huchibang gitlouhna hoih het lou ahi; ahi, vaihawm mite gawt ding khelhna ngei,
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges:

paite: siatna ding a Abaddon tan a kangbei leh, ka punna tengteng zungkalh ding mei hi ding lah ahi ngal a.
english: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

paite: "Ka tung a phunna aneih lai ua, ka sikhapa hiam ka sikhanu hiam makhua na musit a, na khualsak lou ka hihleh;
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me;

paite: Pathian athohkhiak chiang in bang ka hihta dia? Thu akan hun chiang in bang in ka dawngta dia?
english: What then shall I do when God rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?

paite: Kei sul a pan hon bawlpa'n amah abawl kei maw? Khat in ahon bawl tuak ahi kei maw?
english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

paite: "Migentheite alunggulh uh ka piak louh a, ahihkeileh vuaksuak ding a meithai mitte ka na omsakleh;
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

paite: Ahihkeileh kei kia in ka an ka nek a, huai a pabei in an anek keileh;
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

paite: Ii, ka tuailai a kipan in pa bang ka hi, ka kiang ah ana khanglianta; ka nu sul a kipan amah pipa ka hita hi.
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, her have I guided from my mother’s womb);

paite: "Kuapeuh taksap ziak a mangthang hiam, ahihkeileh tasam khuhna nei lou hiam ka na muhleh;
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

paite: Akawngte'n kei hon vualzawl lou a, ka belam mul a lumsak a ana om keileh.
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

paite: "Kongpi a panpihna ka muh ziak a pabeite siatna ding a ka khut ka na likleh;
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,

paite: Huchi ka hihleh, ka liang ka liangzang a kipan kia henla, aguh a kipan ka ban kitan hen.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

paite: Pathian a kipan tuahsia kei a ding in launa ahi ngal a, athupina ka tuak ngam kei hi.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.

paite: "Dangka-eng lametpen a ka na bawl a, dangka-eng hoih kiang ah, ka muanna na hi, ka na chihtak a;
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

paite: Ka hauhna thupi ziak a hiam, ka khut in tam alam ziak a ka kipah a;
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

paite: Avak lai a ni ka na et a, kha thupitak paikhia ka na et a,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

paite: Ka lungtang guk a khem a a-om a, ka kam in ka khut ana tawp takleh;
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,

paite: Hiai leng thulimlouhna vaihawmte gawt ding ahi, tung a Pathian kiang a na zuauta hi ding ka hih ziak in.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.

paite: "Kei hon mudah siatna a ka na kipah a, ahihkeileh hoih lou atung a atun chiang a ka na kipah luatleh;
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him;

paite: Ka melma hamsiat ding leh ahenna thum ding in ka kam ka na khialsak kei.
english: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

paite: Ka puaninte a, 'A-an a kihihvah lou kua a-om a?' hon na chih kei ualeh;
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

paite: Kongzing ah mikhual agiak ngei kei a; khualzin a ding in ka kongte ka na hongta.
english: (the foreigner has not lodged in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

paite: "Adam bang a ka angsung a thulimlouhna na sel a, ka tatlekna na khuh ka hih a,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

paite: aziak, mi tampi launa thupitak ka neih ziak ahih a, sungte hon muh daina launa ziak a huchi a dai dide a, popawt lou ka hihleh,
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

paite: Aw, kei hon za ding mi nei leng maw. Ngai in, ka deihlam hiai ahi. Bangkim hihthei in hon dawng henla; ka melma in laibu ah gelhkhiak hen.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! (behold, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me); let the accuser write my indictment!

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka liangzang ah ka po dia; lallukhu bang in kei ah ka kan den ding hi.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.

paite: Akiang ah ka kalsuan zah ka puang ding a; lal bang in akiangnai ah ka hoh ding hi.
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.

paite: "Ka gam kei dem a akikou a, lei lehsate akahkhawm uleh;
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

paite: Sum lou a huai gahte ka na nek tak a, ahihkeileh huai a aneite ahinna uh ka na tansakleh,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

paite: Buh hilou in louling neite, barli buh hilou in loubualte pou zaw hen," Job thute abeita hi.
english: let briars grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
